ev_0004.summary: Semicircle centered at O on diameter MN (y=301), radius about 237 px, with the arc running from M through the top point P to N. P lies on the arc directly above O, and A lies on segment OP. B lies on the arc and is joined to A by segment AB and to O by radius OB. The CV output supports these points and segments, and all segments are classed as solid. No right angle is claimed: no right-angle marker was verified at O or elsewhere.

Semicircle drawn as an arc from M to N through P (not a full circle). Solid lines only, no fills. No right_angle objects in the GES, so no markers. Labels at 12.5/15 pt per metrics. A and B are taken from their GES positions; the 2-8 px overshoot rule does not apply since no segment overshoots a labelled vertex.
